query: SELECT count(*) AS "count!" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind='r' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attname='tenant' AND NOT a.attisdropped) AND (NOT c.relrowsecurity OR NOT c.relforcerowsecurity)
